headline: Will drop corn hole and Jenga games from holiday events; donut order stays at 1200.
summary: Notes reviewed the October 23 Halloween event and planned holiday activities. Plans cover popcorn, cocoa, cookies, costumes, and tree lighting, where Mayor Cervoni will again arrive as Santa. Prior meeting minutes were not accepted because there was no quorum.
decisions: Corn hole and Jenga games are to be eliminated from the holiday celebrations.
Donut order for next year's Halloween event will stay at 1200.

decision_titles: Dropping corn hole and Jenga games from holiday events
transcript:
# PUBLIC CELEBRATIONS COMMITTEE

Meeting Minutes 11/9/2026

Town Hall Room 205

Attending: Roz Gallagher Debbie Reynolds Erin Benham Ruth Palmer B. Kapi Cheryl De Genovia Megan Foggit

The meeting was called to order at 5:30 by Chairman Roz Gallagher.

No Minutes from the previous meeting were accepted as we lacked a quorum.

A quick digest of the Halloween event on 10/23/26 went as follows:

Cones for the cotton candy stands should be separated before next years event to save time. The donut order of 1200 will be left at that amount again. Cider order to remain the same also. Tables should be set up on the sidewalks, rather than in the street. We distributed 1800 cups of popcorn. Stantions should be used to regulate the donut table. Chairs are needed for some of the workers. The tablecloth rolls were much more efficient than individual ones.

## Seasons of Celebrations:

Mary Ellen Eckles will provide characters once again. Roz has settled everything with the local fire, police, an public works departments. Rotary Club and Sean from Park & Rec will contact volunteers for the dy. Megan will follow up on the Roaming Railroad ride. Liz Landow has firmed up the hot cocoa donated by Choate. Nancy Miller will provide holiday cups from MacDonald's for both the hot cocoa and as back up for Colin Benard's distribution of popcorn, Cheryl asked that long spoon be obtained to stir up the cocoa in the deep urns. Last year we ran out of cookies at 900, possibly a need to increase that order by 100. The corn hole game and jenga are to b eliminated . Frosty and Rudolph costumes are all set. Darryl Porto and former Mayor Bill Dickinson will greet the children at the main entrance of the Town Hall. Elf costumes are in good shape. Tree lighting is all set Mayor Cervoni will arrive at the gazebo area as Santa once again, with arrangements falling on his shoulders.

Our next meeting is to be held 11/23/26 in the same room, same time as usual.

Respectfully submitted by B. Kapi, secretary
